failure.range: Cannot change: the pitch would leave the A0–C8 range
failure.rest: Rests have no pitch, so they cannot be changed
failure.duplicate: Cannot change: the chord already has a note with that pitch
failure.unchanged: The note is already in this state
failure.empty: Select at least one note (not a rest)
failure.tuplet: This note is already in a tuplet, or the insertion point is inside a tuplet (nested tuplets are not supported yet)
failure.tupletFit: The new duration does not fit the tuplet; remove the tuplet first
failure.tupletType: This tuplet cannot be written with the available note shapes (try another tuplet or duration)
failure.noTuplet: The selected note is not in any tuplet
failure.tie: Changing the duration is not supported yet when a note has a tie (the note being edited or one it overlaps)
failure.noSpace: Cannot lengthen: the note would run past the end of the measure
failure.divisions: The score is divided too coarsely to change to this duration
failure.unsupported: This measure structure does not support duration changes yet
failure.tieTarget: A tie needs two adjacent notes of the same pitch in the same voice: select the first note (or both notes)
failure.slurTarget: A slur needs two or more notes selected on the same staff
failure.lyricTarget: Select one note (not a rest or a tied continuation) to enter lyrics
failure.badChord: This chord is not recognized. Examples: C, Am7, G/B, F#m, Bbmaj7, Dsus4, C6/9, N.C.
failure.hairpinTarget: Cresc./dim. needs two or more notes selected (from the first note to the last)
failure.spanTarget: The selection must be on the same staff of the same part
failure.arpeggioTarget: An arpeggio needs a chord of two or more notes: select a chord
failure.glissTarget: A glissando needs two notes on the same staff and voice: select the starting note (the next note is the end) or select both notes
failure.graceTarget: Select a grace note (small note) to toggle the slash
failure.noSection: This measure has no section label
failure.barRepeat: This measure already ends with a repeat sign, so a double barline cannot be added
failure.breakFirst: The first measure always starts a system and the first page: pick a later measure
failure.noRepeat: The last measure of the selection has no end repeat (:|): add an end repeat first
failure.noMeasure: Select a note so the app knows which measure this applies to
failure.lastMeasure: The score must keep at least one measure
failure.voiceMain: This is the main voice of the staff and cannot be removed this way (use the Delete note / Rest button)
failure.hasBass: This part already has two staves (use "Add Treble/Bass staff" to add a separate staff)
failure.lastStaff: The score must keep at least one staff (staff 1 of an instrument can only be removed when another part remains)
failure.noStaff: Select a note or rest so the app knows which staff this applies to
failure.voiceNone: Select notes (not rests or ornaments) to write a voice

flash.dotUnsupported: Cannot change the dot for this duration yet
flash.tupletInput: {name}: input duration {duration}, click a rest to enter notes
flash.nothingToSave: There are no changes to save

toast.chordsLeft: {count} chords have no note to attach to
toast.lyricsLeft: {count} syllables have no note to attach to
toast.restoredNoReload: Restored as version {version} but the score could not be reloaded, please reload the page
toast.draftRestored: Draft restored, press Save to keep it
toast.draftBroken: The draft is corrupted and could not be restored
toast.draftFull: Could not auto-save the draft (the browser is out of space). Press Save to keep your changes.

version.gone: This version no longer exists (only the latest 20 versions are kept)

diff.2901: There is no recognition-generated version to compare with (the score is not from OMR or it is past 20 versions)
diff.2902: A version cannot be compared with itself
diff.2903: These two versions cannot be compared (the MusicXML cannot be read)
diff.2103: The recognition service is temporarily unavailable, please try again later

panel.warning: You have unsaved changes; they will be discarded.
panel.restoreMessage: {warning}Its content will be saved as the newest version; existing versions stay in the history.
panel.title: Version history
panel.empty: The score has no versions yet.
panel.hint: Only the latest 20 versions are kept. Restoring does not delete existing versions.

lyric.hint: Type the lyric for the selected note · Space: next note · "-": word continues · Esc: exit
lyric.hintNone: Select a note (not a rest) to enter lyrics
lyric.pasteHelp: Paste a whole passage: words separated by spaces are assigned to the notes in turn, starting from the selected note (rests and tied continuations are skipped). Use "-" when a word spans several notes (for example "hel-lo"), and a standalone "_" to skip a note. Use "_" between two words (for example "hel_lo") to put both on the same note.

chord.label: Chords
chord.hint: Type a chord, e.g. C, Am7, G/B, C6/9, N.C. · Space: next note · Enter: write · Esc: exit
chord.hintNone: Select a note to enter a chord
chord.pasteHelp: Paste chords separated by spaces or "|": they are assigned to the notes in turn, starting from the selected note. Use "_" to skip a note.

insert.title: Add note
insert.dotTitle: Dot (.): press again for a double dot

notation.title: Clef, key signature & time
notation.selected: Only {range} (then back to how it was)
notation.help: Changing the time signature does not re-flow notes: measures that no longer add up get a red outline for you to fix (or press ✓ to keep them). With free time, measures can be any length and no short/long warning is shown.

staccato.label: Staccato
staccato.title: Staccato: short, detached (press again to remove)

accent.label: Accent
accent.title: Accent: emphasize the note (press again to remove)

tenuto.label: Tenuto
tenuto.title: Tenuto: hold the full length (press again to remove)

fermata.label: Fermata
fermata.title: Fermata: hold freely (press again to remove)

cresc.label: Cresc.
cresc.title: Cresc.: gradually louder, from the first to the last note of the selection

dim.label: Dim.
dim.title: Dim.: gradually softer, from the first to the last note of the selection

fermataBelow.label: Inverted fermata
fermataBelow.title: Inverted fermata (drawn below the note): hold freely (press again to remove)

marcato.label: Marcato
marcato.title: Marcato: strongly accented and detached (press again to remove)

staccatissimo.label: Staccatissimo
staccatissimo.title: Staccatissimo: very short (press again to remove)

breath.label: Breath mark
breath.title: Breath mark after the note: the note is cut slightly short in playback (press again to remove)

caesura.label: Caesura
caesura.title: Caesura //: adds a beat of silence after the note in playback (press again to remove; the preview does not draw this mark yet)

arpeggio.label: Arpeggio
arpeggio.title: Roll the notes of the selected chord from bottom to top (press again to remove)

trill.label: Trill
trill.title: Trill (tr): alternates with the note above (press again to remove)

trillSharp.label: Trill ♯
trillSharp.title: Sharp on the trill: the upper note is raised a semitone (adds a trill if missing; press again to remove the accidental)

trillFlat.label: Trill ♭
trillFlat.title: Flat on the trill: the upper note is lowered a semitone (adds a trill if missing; press again to remove the accidental)

trillNatural.label: Trill ♮
trillNatural.title: Natural on the trill: the upper note follows the natural scale, ignoring the key signature (adds a trill if missing; press again to remove the accidental)

mordent.label: Mordent
mordent.title: Mordent: note – lower note – note (press again to remove)

invMordent.label: Inverted mordent
invMordent.title: Inverted mordent: note – upper note – note (press again to remove)

turn.label: Turn
turn.title: Turn: upper note – note – lower note – note (press again to remove)

pedal.label: Pedal
pedal.title: Pedal: pressed from the first to the last note of the selection (press again to remove)

ottava8va.label: 8va
ottava8va.title: 8va: written an octave lower, sounds an octave higher (press again to remove)

ottava8vb.label: 8vb
ottava8vb.title: 8vb: written an octave higher, sounds an octave lower (press again to remove)

graceSlash.label: Grace (slash)
graceSlash.title: Slashed grace note (acciaccatura): added before the selected note, one step higher

gracePlain.label: Grace (no slash)
gracePlain.title: Unslashed grace note (appoggiatura): added before the selected note, one step higher

graceToggle.label: Toggle grace slash
graceToggle.title: Toggle the selected grace note between slashed (acciaccatura) and unslashed (appoggiatura)

arpeggioDown.label: Roll down
arpeggioDown.title: Roll the notes of the selected chord from top to bottom (press again to remove)

glissando.label: Glissando
glissando.title: Glissando: a wavy line from the selected note to the next one (or to the last note of the selection); press again to remove

slide.label: Slide
slide.title: Slide: a straight line joining two notes like a glissando, without text; press again to remove

repeatStart.title: Repeat sign at the start of the measure (first measure of the selection)

repeatEnd.title: Repeat sign at the end of the measure (last measure of the selection)

volta1.label: Ending 1
volta1.title: Ending 1 (1.) spans the selected measures and closes with a repeat sign

volta2.label: Ending 2
volta2.title: Ending 2 (2.) spans the selected measures: use when the second pass (verse 2) differs at the end

volta3.label: Ending 3
volta3.title: Ending 3 (3.) spans the selected measures, left open: use when there is a third pass

repeatTimes_2.label: Repeat ×2
repeatTimes_2.title: Play the repeated section 2 times (default). Select a measure that has an end repeat :|

repeatTimes_3.label: Repeat ×3
repeatTimes_3.title: Play the repeated section 3 times: set on the end repeat of the last selected measure (needs a preceding :|)

repeatTimes_4.label: Repeat ×4
repeatTimes_4.title: Play the repeated section 4 times: set on the end repeat of the last selected measure (needs a preceding :|)

segno.label: Segno
segno.title: Segno sign at the first measure of the selection

coda.label: Coda
coda.title: Coda sign at the first measure of the selection

dc.label: D.C.
dc.title: D.C.: go back to the beginning (at the end of the last selected measure)

ds.label: D.S.
ds.title: D.S.: go back to the Segno

tocoda.label: To Coda
tocoda.title: To Coda: jump to the Coda

sectionRemove.label: Remove label
sectionRemove.title: Remove the section label from the selected measure

lineBreak.label: Line break
lineBreak.title: Start a new system at the selected measure (press again to remove); only affects page view

pageBreak.label: Page break
pageBreak.title: Start a new page at the selected measure (press again to remove); only affects page view

barDouble.label: Double barline
barDouble.title: Double barline at the end of the last selected measure to separate sections (press again to remove; not allowed on a measure with an end repeat)

tuplet-remove.label: Remove tuplet
tuplet-remove.title: Remove tuplet: merge the whole tuplet containing the selected note into one note (keeps the pitch of the first pitched note)

addBass.label: Add bass (piano)
addBass.title: Add a bass staff below the current staff: two-staff instrument (the staff of the selected note, the first staff by default)

addG.label: Add treble staff
addG.title: Add a separate treble-clef staff (e.g. S/A voices) at the bottom

addF.label: Add separate bass staff
addF.title: Add a separate bass-clef staff (e.g. T/B voices) at the bottom

addTenor.label: Add tenor staff
addTenor.title: Add a separate staff with a treble clef 8vb (Tenor in SATB) at the bottom

removeStaff.label: Delete staff
removeStaff.title: Delete the staff of the selected note (the instrument's bass staff, or a separate staff entirely)

notation.label: Clef · Key · Time…
notation.title: Change the treble/bass/C clef, key signature and time signature (including mid-piece time changes and free time)

insertAfter.label: Add measure after
insertAfter.title: Add an empty measure after the selected one (nothing selected: add at the end)

insertBefore.label: Insert measure before
insertBefore.title: Insert an empty measure before the selected one

deleteMeasure.label: Delete measure
deleteMeasure.title: Delete the measures containing the selected notes (press Undo if you slip)

chordBelow.label: Stacked voice ↓
chordBelow.title: Stacked voice: add to each selected note a note of the same duration a third lower (two notes share one stem)

chordAbove.label: Stacked voice ↑
chordAbove.title: Stacked voice: add a note of the same duration a third higher

blank.label: Separate voice
blank.title: Add a separate (empty) voice: click a rest of the new voice to enter notes with a rhythm different from the main voice

addBelow.label: Copy voice ↓
addBelow.title: Copy the whole measure to a separate voice a third lower, then edit each note's duration and pitch

addAbove.label: Copy voice ↑
addAbove.title: Copy the whole measure to a separate voice a third higher

cue.label: Cue notes
cue.title: Toggle small note heads for the selected notes (often used for secondary voices)

removeVoice.label: Delete voice
removeVoice.title: Delete the separate voice containing the selected note (the main voice cannot be deleted)

tool.note: Click a note to select it (Shift to add more), then use the Pitch group or the arrow keys.

sub.section: Section labels (placed at the start of the selected measure)

input.title: Enter notes: select a rest then press A–G (Esc to exit)
input.label: Enter notes

lyric.title: Enter lyrics: select a note then type a syllable, Space for the next note (Esc to exit)
lyric.label: Lyrics

chord.title: Enter chords: select a note then type Am7, C/G... (Esc to exit)
chord.label: Chords

tool.durationTitle: {label} ({key}) · click: change the duration of the selected notes · drag onto the staff: add a note

dot.label: Dot
dot.title: Dot (.): press twice for a double dot, a third time to remove

tool.breveTitle: Breve (2 whole notes long): click to change the selected notes, or set the input duration
tool.tupletTitle: {label}: {actual} notes in the time of {normal} notes of the same kind (the selected note keeps the first slot, the others are rests to fill in)
tool.dynamicTitle: Dynamic level {d} (placed at the first note of the selection)

dyn.ppp: {d}: extremely soft (placed at the first note of the selection)
dyn.fff: {d}: extremely loud (placed at the first note of the selection)
dyn.accent: {d}: emphasize one note then return to the previous level (placed at the first note of the selection)

sectionForm.title: Set a custom label at the start of the selected measure

tool.sectionTitle: Section label "{name}" ({keywords}) at the start of the selected measure: press again to remove, another label replaces the old one

notFound.title: Score not found
notFound.text: The score does not exist or you do not have permission to view it.

notReady.title: The score is not digitized yet
notReady.text: The score has no MusicXML yet. Wait for recognition to finish or check the progress page.

parseError.title: Cannot read the score
parseError.text: The MusicXML file is broken so it cannot be drawn. You can download the file to check it.

header.invertTitle: Invert score colors (dark background, light notes)

banner.notTwoStaves: The score has {staves} staves (not 2), so the left/right hand cannot be separated later.

view.transposeHint: You can undo (Ctrl+Z) and must press Save to keep it.

status.inputMode: Enter notes · duration {duration} · click the staff to add a note, or select a rest then press A–G
status.issueTitle: Click to scroll to the wrong measure
status.issueAria: Warning: {message}. Click to scroll to the measure
status.hintZoom: Ctrl + scroll or pinch to zoom

draft.title: Restore the unsaved draft?
draft.text: The previous edit was not saved. The draft was auto-saved at {time}.

conflict.title: The score was just saved elsewhere
conflict.newer: The server already has version {latest}, newer than the one you are editing (version {mine}).
conflict.newerUnknown: The server already has a newer version than the one you are editing.
conflict.choose: Choose how to handle your unsaved changes.
conflict.reloadLatest: Load the latest version (discard my changes)

select.desc: Select a note / add to or remove from the selection

drag.keys: Drag a box / drag a note (mouse, pen)
drag.desc: Select an area / drag a note up or down to change its pitch

chord.desc: Select the lower / higher note in a chord

duration.desc: Duration: 16th, eighth, quarter, half, whole (1–5), 32nd, 64th (6–7); breve is under the "Other" button (applies to the selected notes)

dot.desc: Dot: press once for a dot, twice for a double dot, a third time to remove

tuplet.desc: Triplet from the selected note/rest (the Duration group → "Tuplets…" also has duplet, quadruplet, quintuplet, sextuplet, septuplet and "Remove tuplet")

clickStaff.desc: Open the note picker at the exact line/space you clicked, then press Add

dragDuration.keys: Drag a duration button onto the staff
dragDuration.desc: Add a note of that duration where you drop it

letters.desc: Turn the selected note/rest into that note, then move on to the next item

header.keys: Click the title, composer or tempo
header.desc: Edit the text; title and composer also have font size, bold and italic

lyricMode.desc: Select a note, type a syllable then Space for the next note; "-" when a word spans several notes; Esc to exit

chordMode.desc: Select a note, type a chord (C, Am7, G/B, C6/9, N.C....) then Space for the next note; leave empty to delete

staves.desc: Add a bass staff for a keyboard instrument, add a separate treble/bass/Tenor staff (SATB), delete a staff; "Clef · Key · Time…" changes the clef (treble, treble 8vb, bass, C), the key signature and mid-piece time changes

measures.desc: Add after / insert before / delete the selected measures (can be undone)

voices.desc: Stacked voice: add notes of the same duration sharing one stem. Separate voice: a new voice with its own rhythm (click a rest to enter notes). Copy voice: copy the whole measure to a new voice

dynamics.desc: Staccato, Accent, Tenuto, Fermata, Cresc./Dim. (first to last selected note), pp…ff (placed at the first note)

repeats.desc: Repeat signs |: :|, Ending 1 / Ending 2 (verse 2 sings a different ending), Segno, Coda, D.C., D.S., Fine, To Coda

tie.desc: Tie: join the selected note to the next note of the same pitch (press again to remove)

slur.desc: Slur: select from the first to the last note then press (press again to remove)

delete.desc: Delete the selected note (a chord with other notes keeps them)

zoom.desc: Zoom in / zoom out / reset to 100%
